name: Auto-journal naming + in-widget global defaults
description: The Auto-journal widget and Settings must speak one name (Auto-journal, never Shadow Git), and the widget itself must expose the global 'new projects' default so users need not detour into Settings.

steps.comment: ASSERT: no user-visible 'Shadow Git' branding anywhere in the widget
steps.script: (() => { const w = document.querySelector('.helpers-install-widget'); const txt = w?.innerText || ''; const bad = [...txt.matchAll(/shadow[ -]?git/gi)].map(m=>{ const i=m.index; return txt.slice(Math.max(0,i-40), i+40).replace(/\n/g,' '); }); const allowed = bad.filter(s => !/shadow-git-helper|\/shadow-git|bin\/shadow/i.test(s)); return { total: bad.length, disallowed: allowed, PASS: allowed.length === 0 }; })()

steps.comment: ASSERT: the per-project master toggle is named Auto-journal
steps.script: (() => { const w = document.querySelector('.helpers-install-widget'); const lbl = w.querySelector('[data-role="proj-shadow"]')?.closest('.helpers-toggle')?.querySelector('.helpers-toggle-label')?.textContent.trim(); return { lbl, PASS: lbl === 'Enable Auto-journal' }; })()

steps.comment: ASSERT: the widget exposes the GLOBAL default section with both toggles
steps.script: (() => { const w = document.querySelector('.helpers-install-widget'); const ds = w.querySelector('[data-role="default-shadow"]'); const dr = w.querySelector('[data-role="default-rich"]'); const title = [...w.querySelectorAll('.helpers-section-title')].map(e=>e.textContent.trim()); return { title, hasDefaultShadow: !!ds, hasDefaultRich: !!dr, PASS: !!ds && !!dr && title.includes('New projects') }; })()

steps.comment: ASSERT: the global toggle reflects the server value
steps.script: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/api/user/shadow-git-defaults'); const d = await r.json(); const ds = document.querySelector('[data-role="default-shadow"]'); return { server: d.enabled, box: ds.checked, PASS: ds.checked === (d.enabled !== false) }; })()

steps.comment: Flip the GLOBAL default off from inside the widget and confirm it persisted server-side
steps.script: (async () => { document.querySelector('[data-role="default-shadow"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); const d = await (await fetch('/api/user/shadow-git-defaults')).json(); return { server: d.enabled, richUntouched: d.rich_commits, PASS: d.enabled === false && d.rich_commits === true }; })()

steps.comment: Restore the default to ON (auto-journal is a core feature; leave dev as found)
steps.script: (async () => { document.querySelector('[data-role="default-shadow"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); const d = await (await fetch('/api/user/shadow-git-defaults')).json(); return { server: d.enabled, PASS: d.enabled === true }; })()

steps.comment: ASSERT: Settings project section is also renamed, and its default toggles agree
steps.script: (async () => { document.querySelector('.helpers-install-widget [data-role="settings"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500)); const secTitle = document.querySelector('#shadow-git-defaults-section .system-section-title')?.textContent.trim(); const lbl = document.querySelector('#shadow-git-default-enabled')?.closest('.project-toggle')?.querySelector('.project-toggle-label')?.textContent.trim(); const box = document.querySelector('#shadow-git-default-enabled'); return { secTitle, lbl, checked: box?.checked, PASS: secTitle === 'Auto-journal Defaults' && lbl === 'Enable Auto-journal for new projects' && box.checked === true }; })()
